data.title: US evaluates moving CENTCOM forces and naval assets to Israel after Iran war | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: One option is to establish a new base in the Negev big enough to hold the American army’s forces, or to expand one of the Negev’s air force bases and allocate an American compound there.
